abyss-navy.$description: Abyss Navy — Page canvas and card surfaces — the foundational darkness every other element floats on

tide-card.$description: Tide Card — Elevated surface for nested cards, button backgrounds, and section containers — one step lighter than the canvas to imply depth without shadow

spectral-cyan.$description: Spectral Cyan — Hero highlight word, outlined action borders, icon strokes, link borders — the single electric signal that draws the eye through the dark interface

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Primary text, filled action buttons, and high-contrast labels — the only fully white tone, reserved for reading and final calls-to-action

carbon-black.$description: Carbon Black — Hairline borders on dark surfaces and fine dividers — invisible structural lines that define cards without lifting them off the page

fog-gray.$description: Fog Gray — Secondary body copy and muted helper text — lowered brightness to create a clear reading hierarchy beneath Bone White

horizon-glow.$description: Horizon Glow — Gradient atmosphere — the midtone of the radial background bloom that makes the page feel lit from behind

yield-gradient.$description: Yield Gradient — Accent gradient for highlights and yield indicators — teal-to-cyan sweep signaling positive performance

open-sans.$description: Primary typeface across the entire system. Weight 700 carries headings and the hero statement; weight 400 handles body copy and metadata; weight 600 sits on emphasized inline labels. The negative letter-spacing of -0.0360em tightens large display sizes so headlines read as solid blocks rather than airy typography. Hero sizes reach 100px — a deliberate terminal-instrument scale that makes the page feel like a financial readout.

source-sans-pro.$description: Secondary typeface for tabular data, small labels, and inline micro-copy. Its tighter glyph widths complement Open Sans for data-dense rows like TVL figures and percentage chips without competing with display headlines.

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
